ASBESTOS MOTION CALENDAR ON FEB-06-2019 IN 503, PLAINTIFF'S MOTION FOR ORDER GRANTING PREFERENCE IN SETTING CASE FOR TRIAL, AND EXTENDING DISCOVERY CUTOFF. NO OPPOSITION AND TENTATIVE RULING IS AMENDED AS FOLLOWS: PLAINTIFFS' MOTION FOR PREFERENCE IS GRANTED PURSUANT TO C.C.P. 36(A) AND (D). NO OPPOSITION. THE TRIAL DATE IS MAY 28, 2019 AT 11:15A.M. IN DEPARTMENT 503. LAST DAY PURSUANT TO C.C.P. 36(F) IS JUNE 6, 2019. LOCAL RULE 20 SHALL BE FOLLOWED BY THE PARTIES AS WELL AS ALL SAN FRANCISCO LOCAL RULES AND CALIFORNIA RULES OF COURT. THE LAST DAY FOR HEARING SUMMARY JUDGMENT/ADJUDICATION MOTIONS IS MAY 23, 2019. FURTHER CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE ON APRIL 3, 2019 AT 1:30P.M. NO NEED FOR ANY PARTY TO FILE ANY CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE STATEMENT. PARTIES MAY APPEAR AT THE CONFERENCE BY TELEPHONE. IF THE PARTIES AGREE THAT NO CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE IS NECESSARY, THEY SHALL NOTIFY THE COURT AT LEAST TWO DAY PRIOR TO TAKE THE CMC OFF CALENDAR. MANDATORY SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE WITH ONLY THE ATTORNEYS PRESENT AND FINAL DECISION MAKERS AVAILABLE BY PHONE IS SET FOR THURSDAY, MAY 23, 2019 AT 9:30 A.M. IN 603. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: CYNTHIA MING-MEI LEE, CLERK: A. MOK. NOT REPORTED.
